items.caption:
Hypnic jerk: why you jolt awake as you fall asleep.
It is a sleep start: a sudden twitch at the border of sleep, sometimes with a feeling of falling. 60 to 70% of people report them (AASM).

items.caption:
Without sleep, every rat died.
In Allan Rechtschaffen's experiments at the University of Chicago, all rats kept from sleeping without a break died, usually within 2 to 3 weeks (Sleep, 1989).
